mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (below 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, signaling supply chain resilience, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of non-recessionary instances with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $350,000, indicating robust demand for housing, spills over into broader consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with RSAFS above $350,000, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of FEDFUNDS, as a proxy for the overall monetary policy stance, influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with higher rates associated with negative returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.005 over any 1-year rolling window, or SPX returns do not show significant negative correlation with FEDFUNDS levels (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of PAYEMS and UNRATE, where both are increasing, signals labor market overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of labor market overheating instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth below 1,500 units, indicating sluggish housing demand, is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but this effect is muted during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of non-easing instances with HOUST below 1,500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
